description: Search your saved Vasvel cards, notes and collections in ChatGPT. Turn your own saved sources into answers, plans and drafts, with source links. When you explicitly ask and allow saving, bring useful results back as new private notes. Connect your Vasvel account to use your library. This plugin cannot edit or delete existing notes.
